### Workflow and execution

gradle-run, execution `0c783451-a273-4ed5-8e7d-5fed21adb1e3`

### Observed vs. expected

Observed (`bug`):

```text
A :plugin-api:compileTestJava failure through yk gradle printed ~20 "WARN gradle: …warning: [OperatorPrecedence]/[StringSplitter]/sun.misc.Unsafe…" lines, then "WARN gradle: … more problem lines suppressed", then only "ERROR gradle: 1 error" and "* What went wrong". The javac line that says what broke ("ResultCollectorTest.java:27: error: method containsExactly … cannot be applied") was in the log, rated ERROR, but never shown. problemFilter.admit (cli/internal/commands/controlbus/problems.go) counts WARN and ERROR against one per-node cap of 20, in arrival order; compiler warnings come first.
```

Expected: ERROR lines are never crowded out by WARN lines: e.g. a separate (or reserved) budget for ERROR, or WARN capped lower, so the line that failed the node always reaches the watcher.

### How to reproduce

yk gradle :core:compileJava with a compile error in a module that has many javac warnings

### Module

cli

### Priority

P2

title: controlbus watch --quiet: WARN lines use up a node's 20-line cap, so the ERROR that failed it is cut
